name: Cabal of Sorcerers
text: Psykers fill a Cabal pool at the end of your Command phase; it empties at the start of your next one. At any phase start, spend points on Rituals (each once per phase): Weaver of Fates (2) re-rolls one failed save of a THOUSAND SONS unit within 18" of the chosen Psyker; Echoes from the Warp (6) lets that Psyker's unit be targeted by one Stratagem for 0 CP.

name: Cabal of Sorcerers (Ahrak)
text: At the end of your Command phase, while this model is on the battlefield and not Battle-shocked, add 2 to your Cabal pool.

name: Cabal of Sorcerers (Sorcerer)
text: At the end of your Command phase, while the Scarab Occult Sorcerer is on the battlefield and its unit is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to your Cabal pool.

name: Weaver of Fates
text: Ritual effect (2 Cabal points): until the end of the phase, once, when a saving throw fails for a model of a friendly THOUSAND SONS unit within 18" of the chosen Psyker, you may re-roll that save.

name: Glimpse of Eternity
text: Psychic. Once per turn, after a Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll or saving throw is made for this model, you may change that one die to an unmodified 6. The changed die cannot be re-rolled.

name: Implacable Guardians
text: While this unit still contains its Sorcerer, each attack made against it whose Strength is greater than its Toughness subtracts 1 from the Wound roll.

name: Relic Hunters
text: At the end of your Command phase, for each objective marker you control that has at least one unit with this ability within range, roll one D6: on a 4+, add 1 to your Cabal pool. One die per marker, however many such units are on it.
